deals.title: Nintendo Virtual Boy Merch Gets Limited-Time Price Cut
deals.excerpt: Nintendo's Virtual Boy cardboard model kit is now available at a discounted price in select regions for a limited time, ahead of an upcoming service update. Grab it before the promo ends.
deals.translation_zh: 任天堂 Virtual Boy 纸模限时降价
deals.excerpt_zh: 任天堂 Virtual Boy 纸质模型套件在部分地区限时降价促销，服务更新前即将下架，感兴趣的玩家抓紧入手。

deals.title: Last Chance: 88 Games in Nintendo eShop Summer Sale 2026
deals.excerpt: Nintendo's eShop Summer Sale is ending soon — over 88 titles across Switch 1 and Switch 2 are discounted, including multiple games that scored 9/10+. Don't miss out before prices go back up.
deals.translation_zh: 最后机会：任天堂 eShop 夏季促销，88款游戏限时打折
deals.excerpt_zh: 任天堂 eShop 夏季促销即将结束——Switch 1 和 Switch 2 平台超过 88 款游戏正在打折，其中多款评分 9/10 以上。涨价前抓紧入手。

deals.title: LEGO Party Switch 2 Edition Out Now with Free Upgrade
deals.excerpt: LEGO Party's Switch 2 Edition is now available, and existing Switch 1 owners can upgrade for free. Launches alongside Update 1.6 which adds new content.
deals.translation_zh: LEGO Party Switch 2 版上线，老用户免费升级
deals.excerpt_zh: LEGO Party Switch 2 版现已发售，Switch 1 版老玩家可免费升级。同步推出的 1.6 更新加入了全新内容。

deals.title: 12+ New PS5 and PS Plus Games Releasing August 3-9
deals.excerpt: Over a dozen new games are landing on PS5 and PS Plus next week, including major releases and indie gems. Full lineup and release dates inside.
deals.translation_zh: 8月3-9日：12款以上 PS5 和 PS Plus 新游戏即将发售
deals.excerpt_zh: 下周 PS5 和 PS Plus 将迎来十余款新游戏，包括重磅大作和独立佳作。完整发售列表和日期请查看详情。

deals.title: Warning: 8+ PS5/PS4 Games Being Delisted in August 2026
deals.excerpt: Multiple PS5 and PS4 titles are scheduled to be delisted or disabled this month. If any of these are on your wishlist, grab them now before they disappear from the PlayStation Store.
deals.translation_zh: 注意：8月将有8款以上 PS5/PS4 游戏下架
deals.excerpt_zh: 多款 PS5 和 PS4 游戏本月将从 PlayStation Store 下架或停售。心愿单里有这些游戏的话，趁下架前赶紧入手。

deals.title: Complete List: Every PS Plus Game Available Right Now
deals.excerpt: Your complete reference guide to all PlayStation Plus games across Essential, Extra, and Premium tiers. Updated for August 2026 with the latest additions.
deals.translation_zh: 完整清单：PlayStation Plus 现有全部游戏列表
deals.excerpt_zh: PlayStation Plus 三档订阅（Essential、Extra、Premium）现有游戏完整参考列表，已更新至 2026 年 8 月最新内容。

deals.title: Free to Play: Mortal Shell 2 Open Beta Live Now on PS5
deals.excerpt: The open beta for action RPG Mortal Shell 2 is live right now on PS5. Try the soulslike before launch — completely free. Already surpassed 500K downloads on Steam.
deals.translation_zh: 免费试玩：Mortal Shell 2 公测现已登陆 PS5
deals.excerpt_zh: 动作 RPG Mortal Shell 2 公测现已开放，PS5 玩家可免费体验这款类魂游戏。Steam 版下载量已突破 50 万。

deals.title: Xbox Game Pass August 2026: Every New Game Coming Soon
deals.excerpt: Full lineup of Xbox Game Pass additions for August 2026, including day-one releases, indie surprises, and returning fan favorites. Subscribers get all included at no extra cost.
deals.translation_zh: Xbox Game Pass 8月新增游戏完整名单
deals.excerpt_zh: 2026 年 8 月 Xbox Game Pass 新增游戏完整阵容，包括首发同步上架、独立佳作和回归热门。订阅用户无需额外付费。

deals.title: 20+ New Xbox Games Launching August 3-7
deals.excerpt: A packed week for Xbox with over 20 new game releases. From AAA titles to indie gems, here's everything coming to Xbox and Game Pass in the first week of August.
deals.translation_zh: 8月3-7日：20款以上 Xbox 新游戏发售
deals.excerpt_zh: Xbox 迎来繁忙的一周，超过 20 款新游戏即将发售。从 3A 大作到独立精品，以下是 8 月第一周全部发售清单。

deals.title: Gears of War: E-Day Open Beta — Dates and Game Pass Details
deals.excerpt: Gears of War: E-Day open beta dates have been confirmed. Xbox Game Pass subscribers get access — here's the schedule, start times, and what to expect from the new Horde mode.
deals.translation_zh: 战争机器：E-Day 公测时间及 Game Pass 详情
deals.excerpt_zh: 战争机器：E-Day 公测日期已确认，Xbox Game Pass 订阅用户可直接参与。以下是完整时间表和全新 Horde 模式介绍。

deals.title: Corsair Cove Hits Xbox Game Pass Day One — Reviews Are In
deals.excerpt: Corsair Cove is now available on Xbox Game Pass at no extra cost. Early reviews praise the pirate management sim for its depth and charm. Here's what critics are saying.
deals.translation_zh: Corsair Cove 首发登陆 Xbox Game Pass，好评上线
deals.excerpt_zh: 海盗经营模拟游戏 Corsair Cove 现已加入 Xbox Game Pass，无需额外付费。媒体评测好评如潮，称其深度和魅力兼具。

deals.title: Xbox Free Play Days: Try These Games Free (Aug 1-2)
deals.excerpt: Xbox's Free Play Days event lets you try selected games at no cost this weekend. Full list of titles available to try, plus deals if you decide to buy after the trial.
deals.translation_zh: Xbox 免费试玩周末：本周末这些游戏免费玩
deals.excerpt_zh: Xbox 免费试玩活动回归，本周末可免费体验多款精选游戏。以下是完整免费游戏列表，试玩后购买还可享专属折扣。

deals.title: Mistfall Hunter Now on Xbox Game Pass — Reviews Roundup
deals.excerpt: Action RPG Mistfall Hunter launches on Xbox Game Pass today. Early reviews are positive, highlighting the combat system and world design. Here's the full roundup.
deals.translation_zh: Mistfall Hunter 登陆 Xbox Game Pass，媒体评价汇总
deals.excerpt_zh: 动作 RPG Mistfall Hunter 今日加入 Xbox Game Pass。首批评测出炉，战斗系统和世界设计获高度评价。

deals.title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred Expansion — Full Reveal Coming Soon
deals.excerpt: Blizzard is set to share final details about the Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred expansion before launch. Here's what we know so far about the biggest D4 content drop yet.
deals.translation_zh: 暗黑破坏神4：仇恨之主资料片即将全面揭晓
deals.excerpt_zh: 暴雪即将在发售前公布暗黑破坏神4「仇恨之主」资料片的最终详情。以下是这部 D4 史上最大内容更新的已知情报。

deals.title: Heartopia Marks 30M Downloads with New Outfits and Price Cuts
deals.excerpt: Life sim Heartopia celebrates 30 million downloads with a content update that includes new outfits and permanent price cuts on premium items. More accessible than ever.
deals.translation_zh: Heartopia 庆祝3000万下载，新装扮+永久降价
deals.excerpt_zh: 生活模拟游戏 Heartopia 庆祝 3000 万下载里程碑，推出包含新装扮的内容更新，多款付费道具永久降价，门槛更低了。

deals.title: The Petit Planet Beta Returns with New Updates
deals.excerpt: The Petit Planet beta is coming back with fresh content updates. HoYoverse's family-friendly adventure gets new areas and features. Registration still open if you haven't signed up.
deals.translation_zh: Petit Planet 二测回归，全新内容更新
deals.excerpt_zh: 米哈游旗下休闲冒险游戏 Petit Planet 二次测试即将开启，新增地图和功能。尚未注册的玩家仍可报名参与。

deals.title: Mortal Shell 2 Beta Now Live on PS5 and Xbox After Steam Success
deals.excerpt: Following over 500,000 downloads on Steam, the Mortal Shell 2 beta has gone live on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Try this acclaimed soulslike for free while the beta lasts.
deals.translation_zh: Mortal Shell 2 测试版登陆 PS5 和 Xbox，Steam 下载破50万
deals.excerpt_zh: 在 Steam 版下载量突破 50 万后，Mortal Shell 2 测试版现已登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X/S。公测期间可免费体验这款备受好评的类魂游戏。

deals.title: New Super Lucky's Tale (PS4 Digital) — Just $4.50
deals.excerpt: charming 3D platformer New Super Lucky's Tale is currently on sale for $4.50 as a PS4 digital download. That's a massive discount from its regular price — perfect for platformer fans.
deals.translation_zh: New Super Lucky's Tale (PS4 数字版) 仅售 $4.50
deals.excerpt_zh: 3D 平台冒险游戏 New Super Lucky's Tale PS4 数字版限时特价 $4.50，相比原价大幅折扣，平台跳跃游戏爱好者不容错过。

deals.title: LEGO The Hobbit (Steam PC) — Only $2.10
deals.excerpt: LEGO The Hobbit on Steam is currently just $2.10 for a digital PC code. A steal for fans of LEGO games or the Middle-earth universe. Grab it before the sale ends.
deals.translation_zh: LEGO 霍比特人 (Steam PC版) 仅 $2.10
deals.excerpt_zh: LEGO 霍比特人 Steam 数字版限时仅 $2.10，LEGO 系列或中土世界粉丝绝对不能错过这个白菜价。

deals.title: Lords of the Fallen (Steam PC) — From $7.45
deals.excerpt: Dark fantasy action RPG Lords of the Fallen is on sale starting from $7.45 on Steam. A budget-friendly way into one of the most visually impressive soulslikes available.
deals.translation_zh: 堕落之主 (Steam PC版) 低至 $7.45
deals.excerpt_zh: 暗黑奇幻动作 RPG 堕落之主 Steam 版限时低至 $7.45。画面最出色的类魂游戏之一，白菜价入手正合适。
